hook: Your map shows a whole country as a tiny dot.
title: A Whole Country You Can Walk Across
description:
Vatican City is a fully independent country, yet it covers less than half a square kilometre. Zoom out on a map and it shrinks to a speck, and you can walk across it in minutes. It sits entirely inside the city of Rome.

#Shorts #VaticanCity #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
